# Demo Playwright JavaScript for NHS Wales

> A beginner-friendly Playwright + JavaScript/Node demo that drives a real
> Chromium browser against the real, live NHS Wales website
> (https://www.nhs.wales/) and runs three real assertion-based checks.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install and run instructions, and a summary of what the demo tests.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): The exact three test scenarios, selector ids, and expected strings, as the single source of truth.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): Citation metadata for this software.

## Source

- [demo.js](src/demo.js): The Playwright script that implements the three tests described in the spec.

## Optional

- [NHS Wales](https://www.nhs.wales/): The live website this demo tests against.
